meta.title: Fly Maker: market making for your token
meta.description: Fly Maker keeps your token liquid on Robinhood Chain: a vault your wallet owns, on one GIGA DEX pool, run by fly.ai's bot inside guardrails the vault itself enforces.

head.title: Market making for your token
head.lede: Tell it what your token needs, fund a vault your own wallet owns, and fly.ai's bot keeps the market liquid: a steady band of liquidity around the price, or a slow buyback or sale. Every trade stays inside guardrails the vault checks on chain, and you can pause or withdraw any time.

notLive: Fly Maker isn't live yet: you can look up pools and build plans, but vaults can't be created until the contracts are deployed.

about.title: Good to know
about.yours: Your vault is yours. It is created and owned by your wallet. Money can only go back to you, into the vault's one GIGA DEX pool as part of a trade, or to the deposit fee. The bot can trade and move liquidity in that pool; it can't withdraw, change your plan or your guardrails, or unpause.
about.plan: The plan is public. The vault stores the hash of the exact plan text you signed and publishes the text on chain. This page recomputes the hash in your browser; on a mismatch, don't sign.
about.guard: Guardrails. Max trade, a daily cap (any 24 hours, no midnight double), max price impact per trade, and a price check against the pool's 5-minute average, so a pump is never chased. Liquidity moves have their own daily budget.
about.newTokens: New tokens. No GIGA pool yet? Create one here at a starting price you choose; the bot seeds it from your vault with a band beside that price.
about.risks: Risks. Prices move, liquidity can hold more of whichever asset is falling (impermanent loss), every trade pays the pool fee, and the bot can misjudge a market. Small pools mean small trades. Only use what you can afford to lose.

o.changeLede: Paste a new plan text (canonical JSON, like the one below). The vault stores its hash and publishes it; nothing changes until you sign.
o.confirm: Withdraw everything from this vault to {owner}?
o.notCanonical: ✕ not canonical (sorted keys, no spaces): the bot won't run it
o.topUpHint: Fee {pct}% (lower while you hold or stake $FLYAI)
o.withdrawLede: Closes at the current pool price, with no minimum price protection; pauses the vault and sends everything to {owner}. Works even if every fly.ai server is down. The fee already paid is not returned.

p.recenterV: {pct} of the way to the edge

plan.hashOk: ✓ recomputed in your browser. The vault stores the hash of exactly this text and publishes the text on chain.

pool.exists: If someone already made this exact pool (same pair and fee tier), nothing happens and the page just opens it.
pool.lede: There's no GIGA DEX pool of {token} against USDG or WETH. Create one here: you set the starting price, the pool is made and initialized in one transaction, and anyone can trade it once it has liquidity. Then build a Steady band plan and deposit {token}: the bot seeds the empty pool with a band just beside the starting price, so the first buyers buy from your vault.
pool.priceHint: The price the pool opens at. Pick it carefully: it can't be changed once there is liquidity.
pool.title: Create the {token} pool on GIGA DEX

st.activeLine: Active: the bot runs this plan inside the guardrails.
st.pausedLine: Paused: nothing trades until the owner resumes.
st.stoppedLine: Stopped by fly.ai (emergency stop): nothing trades, you can still withdraw.
st.unknownLine: Unknown plan: the plan text on chain doesn't match the stored hash.
st.waitingLine: Waiting: the price is off its 5-minute average, the vault sits still until it catches up.
st.warmupLine: Warming up: the pool needs a few minutes of price history before the vault may trade.

strat.buyLine: Buys a set amount bit by bit over hours or weeks (TWAP).
strat.rangeLine: Keeps liquidity on both sides of the price, re-centers it as the price moves, collects its fees.
strat.sellLine: Sells treasury tokens bit by bit without a big price drop (TWAP).

v.vsHold: vs holding what you put in

warn.fit: These guardrails can't carry the plan on schedule: {why}.
warn.fresh: This pool has no liquidity yet.
warn.freshRange: Deposit {token}: the bot seeds a band just beside the starting price (it can't rebalance by swapping in an empty pool).
warn.freshTwap: A slow buy or sell needs liquidity to trade against: seed the pool with a Steady band first.
warn.impact: A max-size trade would move this pool about {pct}, more than the {limit}% impact guardrail: such trades fill only partly. Consider a smaller max trade.

why.buy: Spreading the buy over time keeps each trade small, so the price isn't pushed up against you. The market can still move over the period.
why.fresh: A brand-new pool: the vault provides its first liquidity.
why.range: A band keeps liquidity on both sides so buyers and sellers always find a price. As the price falls the band holds more token, as it rises more {quote} (impermanent loss); you can end up with less than holding.
why.sell: Spreading the sale over time keeps each trade small, so the price isn't dumped. The market can still move over the period.
why.small: This pool is small ({usd}): trades stay small, and one max-size trade moves the price about {pct} within its active liquidity.
